dialogues.speaker: Medical History of Giyath Khayyam
dialogues.text: "Symptom: Short-term dysmnesia. Gets worse over time. Emotionally unstable, kept talking about adolescence and childhood memories..."

dialogues.speaker: Medical History of Giyath Khayyam
dialogues.text: "...Brain disease of unknown cause. Brain exams show the patient's brain cells have been suffering inactivation from the age of 60, leading to gradual loss of memory faculties..."

dialogues.speaker: Medical History of Giyath Khayyam
dialogues.text: "...Applied for retirement from Amu{RUBY#[S]Biology}rta in Akademiya, in the hope that a stable and comfortable life and psychological environment could slow down the deterioration of the patient's condition..."

dialogues.speaker: Medical History of Giyath Khayyam
dialogues.text: "Amurta announced that the sage Siman Farrokhzad would ensure the patient's treatment is underway..."
